receipts.label: TWO_A

receipts.label: TWO_B
receipts.note: second deposit of the same receipt

receipts.label: FAILED
receipts.note: status 0 receipt with a deposit-looking log

receipts.label: OTHER_EMITTER
receipts.note: deposit log from a contract that is not the remote vault

receipts.label: UNREGISTERED
receipts.note: deposit of a token that is not registered

receipts.label: TYPE5
receipts.note: receipt with an unsupported type byte 5

receipts.label: TYPE0_PREFIXED
receipts.note: receipt with an explicit 0x00 prefix, which no client writes

receipts.label: WRONG_DESTINATION
receipts.note: deposit addressed to another vault of the destination chain
